instructions: Review this as a JetBrains IDE integration for the mirrord CLI. Prioritize lifecycle and concurrency bugs, IntelliJ Platform compatibility, cross-platform behavior (Windows, macOS, Linux, and WSL), preservation of user run configurations, and compatibility with the mirrord CLI contract. Shared behavior belongs in modules/core; product modules should contain only IDE-specific adapters. Compare behavior with metalbear-co/mirrord-vscode when a feature is shared by both IDE integrations. Keep comments high-signal. Do not comment on formatting, whitespace, import ordering, or other issues enforced by ktlint and the Kotlin compiler. Do not request comments that merely restate the code.

rules.rule: Changes to mirrord command construction, environment variables, version checks, download URLs, platform detection, or CLI output parsing must remain compatible with the corresponding behavior in metalbear-co/mirrord. Flag guessed flags, output formats, binary names, or platform mappings that are not supported by the CLI.

Do not perform blocking network, filesystem, process, or wait operations on the IntelliJ event dispatch thread. Long-running work must use an appropriate background task or coroutine, and UI state must only be touched from an IntelliJ-approved UI context.

When adapting a run or debug configuration for mirrord, preserve the user's original executable, arguments, environment, working directory, debugger settings, and cancellation behavior unless the feature explicitly owns that field. Flag in-place mutations that can leak into later runs or changes that overwrite unrelated user configuration.

Behavior shared by multiple JetBrains products belongs in modules/core. Product modules should adapt product-specific APIs and delegate to shared logic; flag copied download, configuration, execution, notification, or lifecycle logic in a product module.
